evals.prompt: BuiltWith says https://context7.com uses Clerk UMP, but Stackray did not detect Clerk. Add the detector if needed and prove it with httpx.
evals.expected_output: Researches upstream Wappalyzer and Clerk signatures, inspects the site in a browser, changes the correct Stackray detection layer, adds focused tests, and verifies the worker httpx output includes Clerk.
expectations: Reads docs/technology-detection.md before editing detection files
Checks upstream Wappalyzer status and product-specific signatures
Uses browser inspection when a real target site is provided
Verifies final detection with worker httpx and -cff

evals.prompt: Stackray already emits a technology named Helply from httpx, but it renders without a website or category. Fix the display metadata only.
evals.expected_output: Identifies this as a metadata-only change, avoids adding a detector, updates custom metadata if needed, and runs metadata-focused tests.

evals.prompt: A scan of a modern SPA should detect a new JavaScript framework, but the only signal is a browser runtime global and a bundle marker. Add detection or explain if the httpx fork is required.
evals.expected_output: Researches local TanStack-style patterns, determines whether Wappalyzer-compatible js/scripts fields are sufficient, verifies JavaScript-heavy evidence with httpx -tdh, or escalates to the httpx fork when evidence is not available to custom fingerprints.
expectations: Uses existing Stackray JS-heavy detector patterns
Chooses between custom fingerprints and httpx fork changes based on available evidence
Includes httpx -tdh scanner verification in the plan or final proof
